text:
Labeling human for /do-beads filter. Bead body presents (a) process-global counter vs (b) state-snapshot-encoded id without a recommendation, and an implicit sub-decision around history bounding. Coupled to cf7p.12 (WS pushState) by the trio's own description ("these three could land as a coordinated cluster").

Specific decisions needed from Mark:

1. Pick (a) vs (b) — process-global counter (needs bounded event history) vs state-snapshot-encoded id (no history needed, but client/server must agree on token format).
2. If (a), ring-buffer size + eviction policy.
3. Confirm testjig-only scope (no propagation to real *-server crates).

Recommendation: option (a) with a 1024-event-per-type ring buffer. Rationale: simpler to implement, matches testjig's NOT-FOR-PRODUCTION posture, doesn't commit any public *-server-crate API to a state-token shape, can be replaced with (b) later if a real consumer pushes back. Land .10 + .12 as one PR with .12 using whatever scheme .10 picks; defer .9 (signal-driven push) as orthogonal polish.

Filed per AGENTS.md "Turn questions into beads" rule.
